newsitem.title: USA: General Instrument tests system in Canada.
newsitem.headline: General Instrument tests system in Canada.

text.p: General Instrument Corp said Wednesday it will provide its MPEG-2 digital network system to BCE Inc unit Bell Canada for testing in two trial locations.

Bell Canada signed equipment contracts for General Instrument encoders, headend and transmission equipment as well as digital set-top terminals. Subscribers in London, Ontario, and Repentigny, Quebec, will be able to receive interactive broadcast services during the trial.
Financial terms of the contract were not announced.
General Instrument develops interactive video, voice and data delivery systems.
